content: Apan mɛ kàmɛn idiim asin u du, idiim mwɛy kyàkölàköl anà kyà ubem: akyeey nsambwaar bàkäärà ntaaŋàmbar nsambwaar yàntsüü, ntɔn u mbwo aya waa un'fur a nkyɛl a Nzam kan'kwo.

Ungö apan mɛ kàmɛn asànaa ngyäl a talàtal wàkölàköl wàŋàtüüb anà mbaa. Baar banswà abà bàwɛl iböŋ udu a ntsür, udu a idiim ande anà udu a un'tal a ikɔb ande bàkäl bàŋàmbar udu a ngyäl a talàtal awà. Ba bàkäl anà isyäŋ kapɛ Nzam kan'kɔɔ aba.
Ba bàkäl mutɔɔl diim a Mɔsɛ, un'syääl a Nzam, anà diim a un'to a un'kɔk:

content.text: « Mwol Nzam, Nkum a indiir byanswà,
isal angye byà byàkölàköl anà byà ubem!
Mwol a in'sɛŋ myanswà, mbwo angye yà balàbal anà yà ndandaa!
Mwol, nà kan'kwo mutɔn ikɔ̈b angye?
ntɔn balàbal angye làkyàmɛnà u leŋ. »

content: Ungö a indiir abi, mɛ kàmɛn idwà kyan'dubà u du, anà ntɛn a imbäl.
Akyeey nsambwaar abà bàkäärà ntaaŋàmbar nsambwaar bàyàtoo uboo a kya. Ba bàkäl bàŋàbwaar ipfɛy a in'kà a ntsür kyà tsɛk tsɛk anà un'kab a wɔl u lɔŋ.
Umwɛy uboo a ikyeer a mɔ̈ɔ̈ inà kàpɛ an'kɔɔb, an'kɔɔb nsambwaar mà wɔl màŋàyɔl a un'fur a nkyɛl a Nzam a mbul a in'tye.
Idwà kyàkäl kyàŋàyɔl a un'diŋ. Kya kyà idiim muswaŋ làkoo anà ngwal a Nzam. Akà mbuur mwɛy kàlàbilà anki uboo a idwà tii umpal yàlàwà ntaaŋàmbar nsambwaar yà akyeey nsambwaar.
